title: On Supporting the younger man throughout
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：support　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 support 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the father ① supported the younger man throughout on the same day, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② supports the younger man throughout before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ support the younger man throughout at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ supported the younger man throughout before — a line in the letter for September 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Supporting the younger man throughout on the same day, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ support four children on one wage before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Support four children on one wage at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ supports four children on one wage on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ supported the younger man throughout again when nobody else would.

⑩ To support the younger man throughout, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody supports the younger man throughout before dawn again and somebody must support the younger man throughout on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 支持（一般过去式 supported the younger man throughout：1957 年父亲头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 支持（一般现在 supports the younger man throughout：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 支持（不定式 to support the younger man throughout：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 支持（过去完成时 had supported the younger man throughout：1951 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 支持（动名词 supporting the younger man throughout 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 供养（support four children on one wage：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去供养靠一份工钱供养四个孩子）
G. v. 供养（support four children on one wage：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 支持（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 supports four children on one wage，而母亲又一次 supported the younger man throughout）

items.q: to support the younger man throughout
supported the younger man throughout before
support four children on one wage before dawn
support four children on one wage at once
supports four children on one wage on the same day
supported the younger man throughout again
to support the younger man throughout

answers.why: support 意为“支持”，1957 年父亲当天就支持自始至终支持那位年轻人，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 supported。
support 意为“支持”，自那以后父亲天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 supports。
support 意为“支持”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯支持自始至终支持那位年轻人”，此处为不定式 to support the younger man throughout。
support 意为“支持”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人支持过，故用过去完成时 had supported。
support 意为“支持”，父亲说“支持自始至终支持那位年轻人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 supporting the younger man throughout 作主语。
support 意为“供养”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去供养靠一份工钱供养四个孩子”，should ever 之后用原形 support four children on one wage。
support 意为“供养”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻供养靠一份工钱供养四个孩子（support four children on one wage at once），以后再也不要提起。
support 意为“支持”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例供养靠一份工钱供养四个孩子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 supports。
support 意为“支持”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就支持自始至终支持那位年轻人，用一般过去式 supported 叙述。
support 意为“支持”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要支持自始至终支持那位年轻人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，父亲当天就支持自始至终支持那位年轻人；老屋里每一个邻居都说这是头一回。（supported the younger man throughout）
多年以后，父亲仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（supports the younger man throughout）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯支持自始至终支持那位年轻人这件事本身。（to support the younger man throughout）
早在 1951 年就有人支持自始至终支持那位年轻人，九月那天家书上的一行字就是证据。（had supported the younger man throughout）
父亲说过，当天就支持自始至终支持那位年轻人这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（supporting the younger man throughout 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻供养靠一份工钱供养四个孩子，以后再也不要提起。（support four children on one wage，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 support 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the father supported the younger man throughout on the same day, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father supports the younger man throughout before dawn whenever the house asks.
Supporting the younger man throughout on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever support four children on one wage before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house supports four children on one wage on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother supported the younger man throughout again, and the house remembered that half.
